name: minecraft-trim-material

schema.description: A trim material for a Minecraft data pack config schema
schema.title: Minecraft Data Pack Trim Material

description:
The trim material you’ll be adding to the pack is identified by the asset name **minecraft:gold_trim**. In‑game it will appear with a golden hue, as indicated by its description color “gold”, and the localization key for its name is **trim.material.gold**.  

To craft this trim, the required ingredient is **minecraft:gold_ingot**, and it should be linked to item model index **2** in the resource files.
